The official Amazon Black Friday sale is now live! Today marks the beginning of its massive 12-day long Black Friday event leading right up to and beyond Thanksgiving and Black Friday with millions of price drops on just about everything. You’ll find loads of Apple deals from AirPods Pro 3 and the lowest prices ever on Apple Watch Series 12, to rare deals on MacBook Neo from $649. All of which join as much as $400 off Google Pixel and Samsung Galaxy gear, you’ll find thousands in savings on TVs, apparel from top brands, kitchen and home goods, gaming gear for your battlestation, the lowest prices ever on the brand new Amazon Android Alexa Tablets, and much more now on sale and up for grabs right here.
